why_this_file_exists: THE ONE PLACE A PER-TASK FLOOR IS RECORDED. Ruled PROMPT-94 s4 after four tasks turned out to have exactly three effective primaries and the director's own test applied: a lower floor for that task, not a stretched map. A floor written into a script would be a second copy of a ruling; a floor written per task in a comment would be fourteen. scripts/rollout-shortfall.mjs reads this file and has no floor of its own beyond the default.

the_rule.three_effective_primaries: floor 6 -- three clauses at the within-task anchor cap of 2.
the_rule.fewer_than_three: NOT GENERATED. Listed for the director with its explanation, because a task that cannot reach three anchorable clauses is a map question and not a generation question.

derivation_note: The floor FOLLOWS from the effective-primary count and the cap: a task with n effective primaries can hold at most 2n secure items without exceeding the cap, so 3 primaries caps at 6. rollout-shortfall therefore DERIVES the floor from the live count rather than reading a number per task -- and this file records the RULE plus the tasks it applied to on the day it was ruled, so a later reader can tell a ruling from a coincidence.

measured_2026_09_29.note_1_2: 1.2 was in this set until the 22989 clause 5.19 promotion (PROMPT-94 s3) took it from 3 effective primaries to 7. It carries the default floor of 8.
measured_2026_09_29.note_5_4: 5.4 has FOUR primary links and three effective: 42001 clause 3.16 is 6 words after its boundary repair, under the 15-word effective-primary floor. The repair LOWERED the effective count, correctly -- the 111 words it used to have were its neighbours'.

expires: This is a ruling about tasks whose maps are thin TODAY. A task that later gains a fourth effective primary returns to the default floor of 8 automatically, because the floor is derived rather than typed. Nothing here needs editing for that to happen.

per_task_overrides._what: A floor the DERIVATION cannot produce, lowered by the director with the measurement behind it. An override is named in every report that uses it, so a lowered floor can never pass as a met one.

4.1.reason: Measured: the only remaining anchorable room is 3.26, a DEFINITION (informative), and every shall anchor is at its cap (6.1.3 sits at 3/2). A Foundation task about the structure of the annexes does not have 8 distinct requirement sentences to test.

5.5.reason: It holds 6 accepted items across 17021-1, 42006 and 42001. A 40-item form draws at most one or two from it, and pushing to 8 means testing certification-body procedure, which was rejected as obscure in PROMPT-104 s1.
